title: Blossom Events
description: Tons of fun events hosted every few weeks to months with tons of players and action!
body:
Blossom events is a minecraft event server where players can come battle to the death until one person or team is remaining! 

We do lots of different types of events from battle royals to civaliaztion events!

If you want to be in a video we have lots of creators who make content on our events too.
